look.why: A cool boreal twilight periwinkle that contrasts warmly with the reddish-grey coat and black ear tufts.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 1.3 m (body 0.8–1.3 m plus short 11–24 cm bobbed tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Boreal taiga forests, temperate mountain woodlands and rocky scrub across Europe, Siberia and Central Asia.

diet.text: Roe deer, chamois, reindeer, mountain hares, grouse and red foxes stalked silently through forest cover.

facts.text: Its long black ear tufts act like sensitive antennae, channeling faint forest sounds into its ears.
Oversized winter paws grow thick fur between the toes, spreading its weight like built-in snowshoes.

id.diet: Rusa roe, chamois, rusa kutub, terwelu gunung, burung belibis, dan rubah merah yang diintai diam-diam.
facts: Jumbai bulu hitam panjang di ujung telinganya membantu mengarahkan suara halus di hutan ke dalam telinga.
Telapak kakinya yang lebar ditumbuhi bulu tebal di musim dingin sehingga berfungsi seperti sepatu salju alami.
